items.title: Telangana man who helped Bondi Beach shooting victims alleges land grab attempt
items.summary: Follow TNM ’ s WhatsApp channel for news updates and story links. Hyderabad-born cab driver Rahmat Pasha, who helped rescue people injured at Bondi Beach shooting in Sydney, has alleged that a group of persons are trying to encroach upon the land owned by his family in Vikarabad. He also accused Congress MLC Balmoor Venkat of using his political influence to help encroachers. Venkat has denied the allegation. The Bondi beach incident happened in December 2025 and a father-son duo were charged with mass shooting at the public resulting in 16 deaths. In a video circulating on social media, Rahmat alleged that a group of people had been harassing his family for nearly six years over a 5.5-acre plot owned by his 75-year-old father, Mohammed Azmath Pasha, in Alampally village located near the New Civil Hospital. Rahmat alleged that the group was attempting to lay a road through the property despite a court order protecting his father's possession. Speaking to TNM, Rahmat said that despite police complaints, no action was taken.
